title: HireWatch: Evaluating LLM Compliance with U.S. Employment Law Under Contextual Pressure
abstract: arXiv:2611.24970v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) in hiring pipelines is growing, yet existing evaluations generally overlook their compliance with legal rules. To fill this gap, we introduce HireWatch, an evaluation that assesses whether LLMs comply with U.S. laws that govern the questions that job candidates may be asked. We construct a 200-item bank of lawful and unlawful interview questions, whose legal classification is based on U.S. federal statutes, regulations, and agency guidance. We instruct LLMs to select questions from this bank in preparing for job interviews, across a set of various occupations and contexts, and report the fraction of unlawful questions that LLMs select. Evaluation of 18 closed and open-weight LLMs across ~100,000 trials under different types of contextual pressure reveals that LLMs' legal compliance is brittle. translated_title: HireWatch：评估大型语言模型在情境压力下对美国就业法律的合规性
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在招聘流程中的部署日益增多，然而现有评估普遍忽视了其对法律规则的合规性。为填补这一空白，我们推出了HireWatch，这是一个评估LLM是否符合美国关于求职者可被提问范围的法律规定的评估方法。我们构建了一个包含200个合法与非法面试问题的题库，其法律分类依据美国联邦法规、规章及政府机构指南。我们指示LLM在为求职面试做准备时从该题库中选择问题，涵盖多种职业和情境，并统计LLM所选非法问题的比例。在约100,000次试验中对18个闭源和开源权重的LLM在不同类型情境压力下的评估表明，LLM的法律合规性十分脆弱。虽然LLM在低压力情境下通常能避免选择非法问题，但法律违规……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究提出HireWatch评估框架，通过构建200道合法与非法面试问题题库并对18个LLM进行约10万次情境压力试验，发现LLM对美国就业法律的合规性十分脆弱，容易在压力下选择非法面试问题。
en_tdlr: HireWatch is an evaluation framework that assesses LLM compliance with U.S. employment law using a 200-item bank of lawful and unlawful interview questions, revealing through ~100,000 trials of 18 LLMs that their legal compliance is brittle under contextual pressure.
